chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Al-Hasan ibn Salih al-Thawri, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
When the camel and the riding animal carry their load independently, then their owner is liable until they reach the place.
ai.seo_question: When is the owner of a loaded animal legally liable according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning liability for animals carrying loads. It establishes that the owner remains responsible for them and what is connected to their transport until they arrive at the designated place.
